questions.text: Should the library extend evening opening hours?
What staffing constraints affect evening opening?

sources.title: SYNTHETIC: library visitor survey
sources.content: Extending evening opening hours would help surveyed library visitors. This synthetic survey covered 40 respondents.

claims.quote: Extending evening opening hours would help surveyed library visitors.

sources.title: SYNTHETIC: staffing memo
sources.content: The library should not extend evening opening hours without additional staffing. Evening staffing constraints include overtime and supervisor availability.

claims.quote: The library should not extend evening opening hours without additional staffing.
